Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what" , so let's go for it!
 🚀 First who? 
Solution-oriented and detail-obsessed — you like catching what others miss.
Proactive, ready to take ownership and improve how things are deployed and automated.
Comfortable working with Agile teams and modern DevOps practices.
 This position is hybrid, 1-2 days/week from the office in Bucharest. 
 🚀 Then what? 
 We’re looking for a Senior DevOps with Azure cloud and strong experience in automation and cloud environments to join our transformation program. You’ll handle containerization, CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, deployments, and ensure applications meet security and performance standards.
 📌 Responsibilities: 
Design, deploy, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure
Manage Terraform state across all environments of deployed applications and configuration versions in line with GitOps best practices
Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitLab for automated build and release flows
Deploy and operate containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS) 
Manage Kubernetes configurations and releases using Helm charts
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Azure environments and Kubernetes clusters
Manage artifact repositories and ensure code quality with tools like SonarQube
Collaborate closely with development teams in an Agile setup
Improve system reliability, scalability, and deployment speed continuously
 ⚙️ Tech stack: 
Technical degree in Computer Science or a similar field
7+ years of DevOps experience in production environments
Strong expertise in Terraform and Azure DevOps 
Strong hands-on work with Azure (infrastructure, services, deployments)
Solid Linux knowledge and Bash scripting
Git-based workflows with GitLab CI/CD
Containerization with Docker
Deployments and configuration using Kubernetes a nd Helm
Experience managing artifact repositories (Artifactory, Nexus) and SonarQube
Used to Agile delivery and working with international teams
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
